rationale: A third-party minor sustained a broken wrist after slipping on the policyholder's icy walkway, and the parents are pursuing medical bills — a clear premises liability scenario covered under the homeowners liability policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jamie Chen (POL-1002) is reporting a premises liability incident in which a neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped on an icy walkway in front of the insured property during an ice storm last week, sustaining a broken wrist. The child's parents are pursuing medical bills. Policy is active with liability coverage up to $500,000 and a $1,000 deductible. Severity is assessed as HIGH due to pediatric injury and unknown full extent of medical and legal exposure.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway, broke her wrist
case_facts.potential_claim_from_third_party: Neighbor's parents are discussing medical bills
